chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Washsha, from Ahmad ibn 'A'idh, from Abi Khadijah, from Abi 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). He replied, 'Verily it is the best of deeds.'

key_terms.أَفْضَل: The best, most superior, or most excellent
key_terms.حُسَيْن: Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him)
key_terms.زِيَارَة: Ziyarah (visitation, specifically of graves or shrines)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual status of visiting the grave of Imam Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s seminal work *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) elevates the visitation of Imam al-Husayn’s shrine to the pinnacle of devotional acts, reflecting the profound theological weight of the Karbala event in Shia spirituality. This designation underscores Ziyarah not merely as a ritual of remembrance, but as a supreme act of worship that connects the believer directly to the Ahl al-Bayt’s legacy of sacrifice and divine love.
